decisions.decision: Docker Compose remains canonical local; Vercel Hobby (web) + Render Free (api) + Neon Free (db) is the approved zero-cost public topology, no card
decisions.rationale: Matches the user's explicit no-payment constraint while keeping the same Django/Next.js images and same-origin proxy architecture

decisions.decision: GitHub Issues + a GitHub Projects board (https://github.com/users/felpennun/projects/1, "SavePoint") now track remaining work, one issue per PLAN.md (not per task), closed via `Closes #N` commit trailers
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested a commit/issue policy this session; documented in full in CONTRIBUTING.md

decisions.decision: seed_demo.py and data/demo/seed-v1.json now key every lookup/comparison by GameWork.canonical_slug, never by GameWork.id
decisions.rationale: GameWork.id is models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4) -- a fresh random value on every independent first import. The manifest's old hardcoded work_id values only ever matched by coincidence in the long-lived local dev DB; Neon's genuinely first import assigned different ids and broke seed_demo. canonical_slug is deterministic across any fresh import and was already present on every interaction as work_slug.

decisions.decision: apps/api/Dockerfile now COPYs docs/ into the image alongside data/
decisions.rationale: import_catalogue's fail-closed freeze check reads docs/verification/catalogue-freeze.md, which previously only existed via the local-only Compose bind mount -- every Render deploy failed at the first startup command until this was added.

decisions.decision: apps/web/middleware.ts's matcher now excludes /health/ alongside /api/, /_next/, favicon.ico
decisions.rationale: The locale-redirect logic was catching /health/ before next.config.ts's dedicated proxy rewrite could run, 307-redirecting it to /es/health/ instead of returning the proxied Django health/commit JSON -- this broke the deployment smoke's revision-marker check by construction, on every environment (never previously exercised via the web proxy locally either).
